fact: In 1902, the Edison Electric Company of Los Angeles surveyed the river in the hope of building a 40-foot rock dam, but the limit of transmission of electric power was 80 miles, with few customers within that limit.
second: That early plan, it seems, lacked the current to go anywhere.
